text: Architecture is a comprehensive discipline that integrates artistic creation, engineering technology, and humanities and social sciences. Its core lies in studying the design, construction, use, and the underlying spatial logic and cultural significance of "architecture". It not only focuses on the appearance and functional practicality of buildings, but also delves deeper into the relationships between architecture and the environment, society, and history, ultimately creating human activity spaces that are both aesthetically pleasing and livable, as well as safe and sustainable. From ancient Greek temples to modern skyscrapers, from rural dwellings to urban planning, architecture has always been an important carrier of human civilization.
